Cockroach Janta Party to hold strategy meeting on August 5

Key members of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) are scheduled to meet on August 5 in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, to decide on future strategies. The meeting will discuss upcoming campaigns, youth-related issues, and the organization's future action plan. Some reports indicate the meeting follows the NEET protest and that the CJP plans a 'nationwide listening tour'. The organization may also discuss expanding its scope.
